GlobalSettings.Privacy.Title: Privacy Policy
GlobalSettings.Privacy.Message:
Last updated: May 22, 2026

Overview
Noctra is a media player and playlist organizer. Noctra does not provide, host, sell, rent, broadcast, or include TV channels, movies, series, playlists, EPG data, streaming links, IPTV subscriptions, or any other media content. You add and control your own content sources.

Information You Provide
The app may store information you enter or create, such as profile names, content source details, playlist information, playback preferences, favorites, hidden categories, watch history, download choices, EPG settings, premium status, and promo code status. This information is used to run app features and personalize your experience.

Local Storage
Noctra is designed to keep app data on your device. We do not sell your personal information. We do not use your playlists or viewing activity for advertising profiles. You can clear watch history and remove profiles or sources from within the app.

Diagnostics and Support
If you choose to send a bug or crash report, your email app may prepare a message that includes basic diagnostics such as app version, device status, operating system information, subscription status, and error details. Reports are sent only when you choose to send them.

Third-Party Services
When you add a provider, playlist, stream, EPG source, or metadata feature, the app may contact the related third-party service to load the information you requested. Third-party services are governed by their own privacy policies and terms. Noctra is not responsible for how those services operate.

Children and Profiles
Noctra includes profile and child-profile features to help organize the viewing experience. These tools do not replace parental supervision and do not guarantee that third-party sources are appropriate for children.

Data Retention
App data remains available until you delete it, clear history, remove profiles or sources, uninstall the app, or reset app data. Some settings may remain as required for app operation, licensing, promo code tracking, or Store entitlement behavior.

Contact
For privacy or support questions, contact: kynora.studio@gmail.com
GlobalSettings.Terms.Title: Terms of Use
GlobalSettings.Terms.Message:
Last updated: May 22, 2026

Acceptance
By using Noctra, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

No Content Provided
Noctra is a media player and playlist organizer. Noctra does not provide, host, sell, rent, broadcast, or include TV channels, movies, series, playlists, EPG data, streaming links, IPTV subscriptions, or any other media content. The app does not grant access to protected, paid, or subscription content.

Your Responsibility
You are responsible for adding only content sources that you own, control, or are legally allowed to access. You are responsible for complying with copyright law, license terms, provider terms, regional laws, and any rules that apply to your content sources.

Copyright and Rights Infringement
Do not use Noctra to access, copy, download, organize, distribute, display, or stream unauthorized, illegal, pirated, or rights-infringing content. Noctra is not designed to bypass subscriptions, paywalls, access controls, DRM, geo-restrictions, or provider restrictions. We may refuse support for use that appears to involve infringement, abuse, or illegal activity.

Third-Party Sources
Providers, playlists, streams, EPG feeds, metadata services, and other third-party sources are controlled by their owners. Noctra is not responsible for their availability, legality, accuracy, quality, safety, pricing, changes, outages, or content.

Downloads and Offline Use
If the app allows download or offline playback from a source you add, you may use that feature only where you have the right to do so. You are responsible for deleting downloaded items when your rights to access them end.

Premium Features and Store Purchases
Noctra may offer Free and Premium editions or features. Premium features can include higher limits, automatic EPG refresh, resume playback, sleep timer, and removal of ads or watermarks. Store purchases, payments, taxes, refunds, and entitlement handling are managed by the Microsoft Store and may be subject to Microsoft Store policies.

Promo Codes
Promo codes may unlock Premium features for a limited time in the Free edition. Promo codes may be limited, expire, become inactive, be restricted to one use per device, or be withdrawn. A valid promo code extends Premium access according to the code duration and does not guarantee future availability. Promo codes are not cash, cannot be redeemed for money, and may not apply to the separate Premium edition.

Prohibited Use
You may not misuse the app, interfere with its operation, reverse engineer protected components, use it for unlawful activity, or use it in a way that violates the rights of others.

Disclaimer
The app is provided as is. Playback quality, metadata, EPG results, provider access, and stream availability can vary. Noctra does not guarantee uninterrupted service, compatibility with every source, or the legality of third-party content.

Changes
We may update these terms when app features, Store requirements, or legal requirements change. Continued use of the app after changes means you accept the updated terms.

Contact
For legal, privacy, or support questions, contact: kynora.studio@gmail.com
